description: This file defines an abstract class 'FineractEvent' which extends Spring's ApplicationEvent and includes additional context information via FineractContext. It serves as a base class for event representations within the Fineract application infrastructure.

classes.name: FineractEvent
classes.description: An abstract class extending ApplicationEvent, adding a FineractContext for richer event information within the Fineract system.
